project.name: Focus Contract Studio
project.summary: A WebMCP-native, human-governed studio that preserves dialog-focus decisions as revisioned precedent, stages unapplied proposals, binds approval to an exact revision, and verifies the resulting live behavior.
project.ai_usage: ChatGPT reasons over page-bound WebMCP tools; the application uses no model API. D1-backed RRF retrieves scoped precedent but never authorizes mutation.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported official-source research, product design, implementation, test-driven repairs, security and adversarial review, release preparation, browser validation, and repository documentation. Exact R13 source-to-Sites evidence and a fresh complete ChatGPT in-app-browser flow are recorded in the public repository; R10 retains the historical Chrome trace for the same four-tool contract. The live Devpost draft is complete except for the entrant's country-of-residence answer, required public video URL, and final submission.
